resources.string: The lock screen appears when the display wakes up.
Lock screen: 3 presses, just like on the Switch

Console setup:

1. Grant the "Display over other apps" permission — without it the lock screen will not appear on wake.
2. Settings → Security → Screen lock → set "None" (recommended: the lock works as an overlay with no flash of the game) or "Swipe".
3. Turn on the "Lock enabled" switch above.
4. Disable battery optimization so the system does not kill the background service.

Unlock: press any button or tap the screen 3 times.
